sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Genjutsu, Harmonic Branch

system.description:
You can only cast this jutsu while you have at least one active Doki.

You command all active Doki to converge on a single target creature within all of their movement range. Each Doki moves into a space adjacent to the target creature. You then command the Doki to each make a melee Ninjutsu (or Taijutsu or Genjutsu) attack against the target creature. You decide the order each Doki attacks. If multiple Doki score a hit, the target creature only makes one saving throw of your choice. On a failure they suffer the effects of all Doki that score a hit.

If the Doki (Bandaged) scores a hit, the target creature takes damage as if they were hit by Revolt of the Demon World twice and must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they take Chakra damage equal to the total damage they take from this Doki and all other Doki as part of this jutsu’s casting.

If the Doki (Claw) scores a hit, the target creature takes damage as if they were hit by Claw twice and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they are Bruised and Dazed.

If the Doki (Club) scores a hit, the target creature takes damage as if they were hit by Club twice and must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are knocked Prone and have their speed reduced to 0 until the end of their next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, each Doki makes two attacks, instead of one.
